analysis.title: Watts Water Technologies Inc. (WTS): Data center momentum drives another raise as 2027 growth normalizes; Neutral
key_insights: WTS reported 3Q26 revenue of $728mn vs GSe/FactSet consensus of $686mn/$693mn. Organic growth was +12% yoy vs the company's +5% to +8% guidance and GSe +6.8%.
Americas organic growth was ~+12% vs GSe +8.2%, on favorable pricing and higher volumes from data center demand. Europe was +9% vs GSe +1.5%. APMEA was +30% vs GSe +7.5%.

3Q26 adjusted operating margin was 20.9%, excluding ~$39mn of tariff refunds, vs company guidance of 19.8%-20.4% and GSe 20.0%. Margin expanded 240bps yoy on pricing, volume leverage and productivity, net of inflation and ~30bps acquisition dilution.
3Q26 adjusted EPS was $3.40 vs GSe/FactSet consensus of $3.13/$3.14.

4Q26 guidance: organic/reported revenue growth of +9% to +12%/+11% to +14% yoy vs GSe +7.9%/+11%. Americas organic is guided to +11% to +14% (GSe +10.5%), Europe +2% to +5% (GSe -1%), APMEA +9% to +12%.
4Q26 adjusted operating margin guidance of 19.1%-19.7% is below GSe 19.8%, reflecting sequential margin moderation in the Americas and APMEA amid inflationary pressures.

FY2026 outlook raised to organic/reported revenue growth of +11% to +12%/+17% to +18%, from +8% to +11%/+14% to +17%, vs GSe +9.8%/+16%. FY2026 adjusted operating margin outlook raised to 20.3%-20.4% from 19.8%-20.4%, implying +70bps to +80bps yoy expansion.
Management expects FY2026 free cash flow conversion of at least 90% of net income, with seasonally strong 4Q26 free cash flow.

Data centers reached the high end of a high-single-digit percentage of sales in 3Q26, up from ~3% in 2025. Management expects the data center market to grow ~15%-20% in 2027 and WTS to grow roughly in line with it, after more than doubling data center revenue in 2026.

Most of the expected 2027 data center business relates to already-permitted projects with committed contractor work, which reduces delay risk. Growth should moderate as it laps share gains and new product ramps.

North American construction markets softened further. Residential new construction and non-institutional commercial are expected to stay pressured into 2027, while institutional and repair/replacement demand are resilient. Year-end 2027 is the best-case timing for a residential recovery.
GS 2026-2028 non-GAAP EPS estimates move 2%/(2%)/0% to $13.17/$14.16/$15.43 on stronger near-term execution and softer long-term growth.
GS keeps a Neutral rating. The 12-month price target is $365 (from $374), based on 24X (from 25X) on Q5-Q8 EPS, on a softer 2027 outlook. Price was $347.46, implying 5.0% upside.

market_movers.rationale: Price target cut to $365 from $374 as the multiple falls to 24X from 25X on a softer 2027 outlook. Rating stays Neutral after a 3Q26 beat and a raised FY2026 outlook.

sector_views.rationale: Data center and liquid cooling demand drives growth, while soft North American residential and non-institutional commercial construction caps cyclical upside into 2027.

Softer North American residential and non-institutional commercial construction into 2027.
geopolitical: The company's FY2026 outlook assumes current Middle East conditions persist and reflects the estimated impact of current and announced tariffs.

tension_points.bull_case: Data centers grew to the high end of high-single-digit percent of sales, with 2027 data center market growth of ~15%-20%, visibility from permitted projects, and growing liquid cooling exposure.
tension_points.bear_case: North American residential new construction and non-institutional commercial are expected to stay pressured into 2027, and 4Q26 margin guidance is below GS expectations.
